text:
Avi: Quick sync — we need to lock down per-customer flag plan for enterprise_feature_x (Acme + BetaCorp). Contract gating + VIP allowlist. Two quick Qs: do we evaluate by contract_id at request time or set a cached customer flag?

Mira: I'd lean cached flag on our config service for latency, but we need immediate revocation support for contract changes.

Jon: +1 cached for perf. We can add a short ttl (30s) and a pub/sub invalidation when contract status changes.

Kaori: For audit + billing we must log: who flipped the flag, contract_version, and which allowlist matched. Also add a telemetry tag for "enterprise_vip".

Avi: Good call. For canary audiences: do we do account-level canaries (enable entire account) or percent-of-users inside an account? Example: Acme wants a progressive rollout to 3 of their teams.

Mira: Account-level canary is simpler for enterprise customers. They often want predictable behavior for billing and support. Percent rollouts inside account can be noisy.

Jon: We should support both, but default to account-level canary. Add fields: canary_accounts (array) + percent_users (optional).

Avi: Proposed feature config (will put in infra flags store):
```
featureFlags:
  enterprise_feature_x:
    mode: "customer"
    allowlist_customers: ["acme_corp", "betacorp"]
    contract_gate: "contract_v2"
    vip_users: ["u-123", "u-456"]
    rollout:
      canary_accounts: ["acme-team-3"]
      percent_users: 0.01
    revoke_ttl_seconds: 30  # pub/sub invalidation window
```

Kaori: That looks good. Suggest adding "audit_reason" metadata on manual toggles and a required changelist for enterprise toggles.

Mira: For guardrails: automatic fallback to a safe smaller model variant + alert on error rate spike when enabling for a customer. Should we wire that into rollout policy?

Jon: Yes — rollout policy should include failure thresholds. Example: if error_rate > 2% or latency p95 increases by >200ms for the customer, auto-disable and notify #incidents.

Avi: I'll add that to the rollout schema. Also opening a PR for the config + SDK changes: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4321 — please review.

deploy-bot: Deploy check OK: infra-config lint passed for flag schema changes.

ops-bot: FYI — audit logs enabled for flags. Retention=90d per compliance request.

Mira: For canary scheduling — recommend we gate canary enrollment behind contract effective_date and a manual "start_canary" toggle in console. That avoids accidental early rollouts.

Jon: I'll add console UX text: "Start canary for specified accounts; auto rollback on threshold breach."

Kaori: Should we expose a "VIP bypass" for support engineers to reproduce customer issues? Needs strict RBAC and an audited button.

Avi: Yes — implement as a temporary JWT-scoped override that expires and is logged. Only allowed for role:support with 2FA.

Mira: TL;DR action items:
- Avi: update flag schema with rollout failure thresholds + revoke_ttl (PR #4321)
- Jon: add pub/sub invalidation + console copy
- Kaori: define audit fields + RBAC for VIP bypass
- Mira: update runbook for auto-rollback notification

Avi: Thanks — I'll push the follow-ups today and @mira please add the runbook bits. Marking this resolved unless anyone objects. :slightly_smiling_face:
